paraphrase: The realm of beings neither decreases nor increases: those who think beings decrease (by nirvāṇa) or increase hold wrong views. The realm of beings is the tathāgatagarbha, the tathāgatagarbha is the dharmakāya — one dharmadhātu, which has three aspects: endowed from beginningless time with inseparable pure qualities; covered by beginningless separable defilements; and equal to the end of time, permanent.
